title: Release Manager
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

The Software Release Manager II will plan, coordinate, ensure notifications are sent in a timely manner, and schedule software releases in alignment with organizational strategy and goals. This role works closely with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure the quality and timeliness of releases , monitor and report progress during the release windows, and identify areas for improvement through testing feedback. The position also develops reports and metrics to communicate release performance to leadership.


Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, communicate, schedule, and facilitate software releases to meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with development, QA, operations, and change management teams to ensure readiness and quality.
  • Monitor and communicate release progress, identify risks, and escalate issues as needed.
  • Facilitate release meetings and maintain release calendars.
  • Review testing outcomes and work with QA to address defects and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain release documentation, including release notes and rollback plans.
  • Produce reports and metrics on release performance and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with InComm’s release management policies and best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives for release processes.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred.
  • 4+ years of experience in release coordination, change management, or related IT governance roles.
  • Familiarity with SDLC processes and testing practices.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills; ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, or similar for tracking and documentation.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Understanding of release governance, risk management, and quality assurance principles.
  • Analytical skills to interpret metrics and identify process improvements.
  • Comfortable working in Agile or iterative development environments.


Benefits

R$340 home office allowance

️ R$1,150 meal/food allowance (VR/VA)

10% annual bonus

Sul América health/dental plan

title: Medical Science Liaison - Dermatology - Brazil
description:
Canopy Life Sciences is a well-respected vendor & partner in the life sciences industry, assisting pharmaceutical and life sciences clients in various functional areas of expertise. Our culture is one of empowerment. Everyone has a voice and plays a role in the success of the business and a role in developing our values & behaviors. We recruit, train, and develop people to ensure the very best for our client partners.



Medical Science Liaison – Dermatology - Brazil


This role requires a professional with a strong background in dermatology or rheumatology, extensive experience supporting clinical trials, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will serve as a key scientific resource, building relationships with stakeholders, facilitating clinical trial activities, and generating insights to inform strategy and improve patient outcomes.


Key Responsibilities:


Clinical Trial Support :


  • Collaborate with clinical trial teams to support trial enrollment efforts, including identifying suitable patients and optimizing recruitment strategies.
  • Engage with clinical trial sites and investigators to ensure smooth trial operations and alignment with study objectives.
  • Provide education and training to clinical sites on study protocols and therapeutic areas.


Insight Generation and Framework Creation :


  • Gather and synthesize insights from healthcare professionals (HCPs), patients, and other stakeholders to identify referral patterns, challenges, and opportunities for trial enrollment.
  • Develop frameworks to streamline patient identification and referral pathways.


Stakeholder Engagement :


  • Build and maintain relationships with HCPs, clinical trial investigators, and other key opinion leaders (KOLs) in dermatology.
  • Act as a liaison between clinical sites, investigators, and internal teams to ensure effective communication and support.


Cross-Border Collaboration :


  • Work across national borders to address global clinical trial needs and ensure compliance with international regulations and cultural nuances.
  • Collaborate with global teams to align on strategies and share best practices.


Travel Requirements :


  • Travel extensively to meet with stakeholders, support trial sites, and attend relevant conferences and events.


Independent Work :


  • Operate autonomously to manage responsibilities, meet deadlines, and drive projects forward while maintaining alignment with organizational goals.


Qualifications and Experience:


  • A minimum of 3 years of experience as a Medical Science Liaison or in a similar role.
  • Strong background in dermatology or rheumatology, with experience engaging with dermatologist-focused clinical trial sites and investigators.
  • Proven track record of supporting clinical trial enrollment, patient identification, and site engagement.
  • Experience generating insights and developing frameworks to address complex challenges in clinical trial operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify patient referral patterns and address barriers to patient participation.
  • Willingness to travel extensively, including international travel.
  • Experience working in cross-border settings and collaborating with global teams.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently.


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Advanced degree (e.g., PharmD, PhD, MD) in a relevant field is highly desirable.
  • Experience with insight generation in the context of dermatology or rheumatology clinical trials.
  • Knowledge of global regulatory environments and best practices in clinical trial management.




Compensation - DOE

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Product Owner– AI-Powered Platform
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a Product Owner of an AI-Powered SaaS Solution, you will lead the delivery and integration of AI and automation capabilities across a suite of SaaS products. This role bridges product strategy with execution—translating business needs into technical requirements and ensuring that AI-driven features deliver measurable value. The ideal candidate will coordinate closely with data science, engineering, and product teams to build scalable, high-impact AI solutions that enhance user experience and business performance.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Drive the execution and delivery of AI-powered features, use cases, and platform capabilities across multiple SaaS products;
  • Translate business and product team requirements into actionable technical stories and sprint deliverables for data science and engineering teams;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional squads to embed AI and automation into existing product workflows (e.g., recruiting, onboarding, performance, learning, analytics, and public safety);
  • Define and manage the product backlog for AI feature delivery, striking a balance between immediate priorities and long-term platform scalability;
  • Develop execution roadmaps, milestones, and release plans for model training, integration, and deployment across multiple product lines;
  • Track key performance indicators (velocity, cycle time, release quality, adoption metrics) to ensure continuous improvement in delivery efficiency;
  • Oversee post-deployment validation, ensuring model accuracy, reliability, and user experience alignment.


Essential Skills

  • Proven experience managing AI/ML-driven product initiatives within SaaS environments;
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies and end-to-end product lifecycle management;
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business terms;
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to define success metrics and measure adoption and performance;
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams (engineering, data science, product, and UX).


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with machine learning model lifecycle management—from concept to deployment;
  • Familiarity with AI integration in enterprise SaaS systems, including automation, natural language processing (NLP), and predictive analytics;
  • Understanding of MLOps, model monitoring, and continuous improvement practices;
  • Ability to balance innovation with scalability and compliance requirements.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

The ideal candidate will coordinate closely with data science, engineering, and product teams to build scalable, high-impact AI solutions that enhance user experience and business performance.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Drive the execution and delivery of AI-powered features, use cases, and platform capabilities across multiple SaaS products;
  • Translate business and product team requirements into actionable technical stories and sprint deliverables for data science and engineering teams;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional squads to embed AI and automation into existing product workflows (e.g., recruiting, onboarding, performance, learning, analytics, and public safety);
  • Define and manage the product backlog for AI feature delivery, striking a balance between immediate priorities and long-term platform scalability;
  • Develop execution roadmaps, milestones, and release plans for model training, integration, and deployment across multiple product lines;
  • Track key performance indicators (velocity, cycle time, release quality, adoption metrics) to ensure continuous improvement in delivery efficiency;
  • Oversee post-deployment validation, ensuring model accuracy, reliability, and user experience alignment.


Essential Skills

  • Proven experience managing AI/ML-driven product initiatives within SaaS environments;
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies and end-to-end product lifecycle management;
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business terms;
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to define success metrics and measure adoption and performance;
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams (engineering, data science, product, and UX).


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with machine learning model lifecycle management—from concept to deployment;
  • Familiarity with AI integration in enterprise SaaS systems, including automation, natural language processing (NLP), and predictive analytics;
  • Understanding of MLOps, model monitoring, and continuous improvement practices;
  • Ability to balance innovation with scalability and compliance requirements.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços e aplicações em Java, garantindo alta performance, escalabilidade e segurança;
  • Construir, testar e implantar agentes de IA para automação de processos de negócio;
  • Integrar LLMs com APIs, bancos de dados, serviços externos e ferramentas corporativas;

  • Atuar em troubleshooting de ambientes de desenvolvimento, homologação e produção.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines de CI/CD para build, teste e deploy contínuo;
  • Utilizar conteinerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes) para implantações;
  • Assegurar observabilidade e monitoramento de workflows agentic AI;
  • Participar de code reviews, sessões de compartilhamento de conhecimento e cerimônias ágeis;
  • Prestar suporte técnico e atuar como referência para demandas de média e alta complexidade;
  • Revisar e manter documentação detalhada de arquitetura, componentes, integrações e processos de deploy;
  • Registrar decisões técnicas e padrões adotados para uso de IA e automação.



Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, ou correlatos;


Experiência em:

  • Desenvolvimento Java e POO,
  • Microsserviços e APIs REST,
  • Automação de testes (unitários, integração ou funcionais),
  • Ferramentas GIT,
  • LLMs e frameworks de IA (ex: LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel);


Domínio em Java e Python

  • Node.js ou outra linguagem é diferencial;


Conhecimento em bancos de dados (SQL Server, Oracle, Cassandra ou similares);


Noções de vetores, embeddings e bancos de dados vetoriais;


Compreensão de APIs, microservices e conceitos básicos de cloud;


Boa capacidade de depuração, troubleshooting e comunicação técnica;


Inglês em nível avançado/fluente para contato diário com equipes internacionais.



Seria interessante se você tivesse:


Experiência em:

  • Multi-agent systems ou agents com function-calling,
  • TDD ou BDD,
  • Conteinerização com Docker e orquestração com Kubernetes;


Conhecimento em:

  • Grafos e Graph DBs (ex: Neo4j),
  • Ferramentas de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions),
  • Observabilidade e monitoramento (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK),
  • Telecom (não obrigatório);


Familiaridade com plataformas de cloud.



Informações adicionais


Horário de trabalho : Segunda a sexta, das 08h às 12h e das 13h às 17h.


Local de trabalho: As atividades poderão ser realizadas em regime de teletrabalho “Home Office”.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

#Missão do cargo

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. Seu objetivo será simplificar e abstrair a plataforma, tornando-a mais eficiente e fácil de usar. Suas responsabilidades incluirão evoluir nosso motor de ingestão de dados, desenvolver protótipos para provas de conceito, manter nossa plataforma de dados na cloud (GCP) e realizar o troubleshooting da plataforma com métricas customizadas. Em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, você agregará conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo soluções para nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, qualidade do código e arquitetura, visando um trabalho harmônico em equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas através da participação ativa em Code Reviews e do desenvolvimento de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar a Plataforma de Dados da Neoway;
  • Propor e criar ferramentas e pipelines de dados eficientes;
  • Manter e otimizar a plataforma de dados para ingestão, coleta e distribuição dos dados;
  • Fomentar e evoluir a cultura de engenharia de software no time;
  • Oferecer suporte e consultoria aos engenheiros de dados da plataforma;
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e Python;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões de alta performance;
  • Demonstrar prudência e cuidado no gerenciamento de grandes volumes de dados;


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros.
  • Conhecer sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção à entrega e subsequente monitoramento;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento com seus pares;
  • Promover o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe;
  • Ter experienciado práticas com Code Review e Feedback;
  • Conhecimento avançado em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação;
  • Conhecimento de desenvolvimento na linguagem Golang;
  • Experiência na construção de APIs REST;
  • Experiência em execução de sistemas baseados em containers (Docker);
  • Experiência nos processos de versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e/ou não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura e Cloud, de preferência GCP;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre Big Data, como por exemplo Datalake, catálogo de esquemas e metadados;


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Ter sido responsável por um projeto de ponta a ponta, incluindo desenvolvimento, deploy e monitoramento;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de sistemas baseados em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Experiência com Infra as a Code (Terraform e Ansible);
  • Experiência com Kafka;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes;
  • Experiência com processamento distribuído (e.g., Spark);
  • Expertise com governança de dados: qualidade, linhagem de dados e segurança;
  • Conhecimento avançado sobre Big Data e Plataformas de dados;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados em batch com Apache Beam
  • Experiência com Apache Iceberg
  • Ter trabalhado em time de plataforma na área de Big Data;
  • Desenvolvimento focado no usuário, desde a concepção até o feedback contínuo;

description:
Descrição da Função


Esta é uma função remota em tempo integral para Analista de Dados . O Analista de Dados será responsável por coletar, organizar, analisar e interpretar grandes conjuntos de dados para identificar padrões e tendências. A coleta ocorrerá em bancos de dados próprios bem como a busca de dados em bases externas, de forma automatizada e também de forma manual (que pode vir a ser automatizada, fazendo parte da função). Também irá desenvolver e manter painéis de dados (dashboards), criar modelos de dados e auxiliar na melhoria dos processos de tomada de decisão do negócio, alimentar e criar planilhas. title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js + Terraform)
description:
About the Opportunity


We are seeking a Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.


Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Lead and own DevOps initiatives , including CI/CD pipeline management, cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform , ensuring secure, reproducible, and automated deployments.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing systems .
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness and compliance with security best practices .
  • Manage and optimize AWS services (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, IAM, VPC, ECR, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker images in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation .
  • Collaborate across engineering teams (Platform, Security, UX) to ensure seamless integration and delivery.


Required Qualifications


  • Professional experience in functional programming , with Node.js / JavaScript.
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and cloud-native environments .
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker .
  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Professional experience with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.
  • Pragmatic mindset with a strong sense of ownership and craftsmanship .

title: PLM Engineer III
description:
PLM Engineer III @ Remote


Job Summary:

In this role, the PLM Engineer III will serve as a technical expert in the areas of infrastructure related to manufacturing information systems. The engineer will identify methods and architect solutions to provide a high level of service to end-users of the application(s). This role will help build out, maintain, and troubleshoot a rapidly expanding application system and its infrastructure. The Engineer will work closely with other engineers, analysts, and leadership to obtain regular feedback on design and execution. Additionally, the Engineer will provide periodic operational support and maintenance of the manufacturing systems.


Essential Duties:

• Responsible for the maintenance, optimization, troubleshooting, upgrades, installation and documentation of infrastructure related to Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems which

includes PLM database management, project management systems, CAD and PDM systems,

• Administration of new and existing technologies, including the design, documentation, install, configuration, maintenance, integration, and testing related systems

• Leads collaboratively with business customers on hardware, middleware, and application requirements.

• Leads with vendors, engineers, analysts, and leadership to ensure the integrity of databases, application software and data

• Performs regular system monitoring, verifying the integrity, health and availability of all systems and key processes, reviewing application and system logs, and ensuring completion of scheduled jobs

• Leads problem-solving efforts regarding system and service matters and if necessary, facilitates support with outside personnel, organizations, and/or vendors

• Monitor tech-industry trends, and brings new ideas and innovative solutions

• Develop new deliverables as needed based on operational requirements and following best practices for documentation and delivery

• Analyzes data to drive decision making and recommendations.

• Configure and deploy devices and peripherals as necessary

• Resolves issues, problems and questions on-site assigned from a ticketing system


Qualifications: Requirements - Required and/or Preferred


Education:

• Basic: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, or similar discipline, and/or equivalent related work experience

• Preferred: PLM Certification


Essential Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience with ARAS (PLM tool) and SolidWorks (CAD system)

• Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience in a factory or enterprise setting

• Minimum of 2+ years of hands-on experience with PLM

• Technical expertise with PLM systems such as CAD, PDM, ERP, PMO

• Excellent communication (oral and written) skills, including the ability to explain and present technical information

• Effectively train and advise users on information technology issues

• Prepare written documentation in a clear and concise style

• Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, flexible environment and take the initiative to learn new tools and concepts quickly

• Creative thinker with attention to detail, strong analytical, multitasking, and interpersonal skills

• Approachable and adaptable

• Ability to work extended-hours or outside of normal business hours including weekends as needed

• Skills in MS Office (Word, Power Point, Excel, Outlook)

• Must have working-level knowledge of the English language, including reading, writing, and speaking English


Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior experience in a factory environment desirable

• Technical experience with database management & language (SQL, Oracle)

• Able to work independently and in a team environment, as well as with cross-functional groups

• Resilient, self-motived and able to work well under pressure

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei profissional de desenvolvimento, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Atuação em desenvolvimento Back end com Java 17 ou superior , Spring Boot 3+, Spring 6+, Quarkus e GraalVM.
  • Domínio de conceitos DevOps e GitOps , com experiência em Git, Git Flow, Github, Github Actions, Itaú IUPipes 2.0, Terraform, Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e DDD , além de experiência com monitoramento usando Datadog .
  • Vivência com mensageria , tendo como principal tecnologia o Apache Kafka.
  • Experiência prática nos principais serviços da AWS (VPC, Route 53, Cloudfront, EC2, ECS, ECR, EKS, Lambda, ELB, DynamoDB, RDS Postgres, ElastiCache, OpenSearch, KeySpaces, SNS, SQS, Kinesis, entre outros...).
  • Conhecimento em integração e orquestração de serviços AWS.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: UX/UI DESIGN
description:
Olá, somos a ETUS

Somos uma MadTech, atuamos na interseção entre marketing, mídia e tecnologia, com soluções que conectam marcas e pessoas de forma estratégica, automatizada e orientada por dados.

ETUS significa Eu Tenho Um Sonho. Nascemos com o propósito de transformar vidas por meio do empreendedorismo, da inclusão e da inovação. Em poucos anos, construímos um ecossistema completo de empresas focadas em performance, mídia programática, inteligência de dados, tecnologia SaaS e otimização de conversão (CRO).

Hoje, impactamos milhões de pessoas, com uma equipe apaixonada por desafios, crescimento e propósito. Aqui, acreditamos que sonhar é o primeiro passo para transformar realidades.

Se você procura um ambiente dinâmico, e já se imaginou trabalhando com um bando de gente incrível, que ama o impossível e está sempre disposta a mudar o jogo, seu lugar é aqui.


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa UX/UI Design Pleno para atuar com foco em CRO (Otimização de Conversão), desenvolvendo interfaces digitais estratégicas para sites, landing pages e fluxos de conversão. Essa pessoa atuará em parceria direta com o time de CRO, transformando diagnósticos, pesquisas e wireframes em interfaces visuais consistentes, funcionais e orientadas a resultados.

A posição é indicada para quem entende que design vai além da estética e atua como ferramenta de clareza, impacto visual e performance de negócio.


Suas responsabilidades incluirão:

● Criar layouts de alta fidelidade para sites, landing pages e fluxos digitais, com foco em conversão.

● Transformar wireframes de baixa fidelidade em interfaces visuais bem resolvidas, consistentes e alinhadas ao posicionamento das marcas.

● Trabalhar em parceria direta com Estrategistas de CRO, recebendo diagnósticos, pesquisas, copy e direcionamentos que servirão como base para a criação das interfaces.

● Adaptar layouts para desktop e mobile, garantindo hierarquia visual, responsividade e boa experiência do usuário.

● Criar, manter e evoluir componentes, padrões visuais e estruturas de design system quando necessário.

● Atuar simultaneamente em múltiplos projetos e clientes de diferentes segmentos, como bancos, fintechs, SaaS, e-commerce e geração de leads.


Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios:

● Experiência sólida com UI Design, especialmente para sites e landing pages.

● Domínio avançado de Figma, incluindo componentes, Auto Layout e protótipos navegáveis.

● Portfólio online com projetos de UI Design (item indispensável no processo seletivo).

● Boa base em UX/UI Design, com foco em clareza, usabilidade e simplificação de problemas complexos.

● Experiência ou familiaridade com design systems e organização de componentes.

● Capacidade de executar com qualidade a partir de orientações claras, mantendo criatividade, organização e alinhamento com o time.

● Autonomia, senso de responsabilidade, comprometimento com prazos e boa gestão de demandas.

● Boa comunicação e abertura para dar e receber feedbacks.


Diferenciais desejáveis:

● Experiência prévia com projetos de CRO, testes A/B ou otimização de conversão.

● Conhecimento em Photoshop e Illustrator.

● Uso de ferramentas de IA no processo de criação ou edição de imagens.

● Experiência na criação de sites e landing pages do zero no Figma.

● Interesse genuíno por tendências de design e evolução constante do repertório visual.


O que faz a diferença por aqui: Nosso clube PLUS

️ iFood Benefícios – Crédito mensal para você escolher onde e o que quiser comer, com liberdade e praticidade.

Wellhub | Gympass – Acesso a academias, personal trainers, estúdios e apps de bem-estar para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico AMIL ONE – Sem mensalidade para você e seus filhos (até 18 anos), e sem coparticipação. Cuidado de ponta, sem custo extra.

Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida – Tempo de qualidade com quem mais importa.

Vale Celebration – Um mimo em momentos importantes como casamento, nascimento de filhos e aniversário.

️ ♂️ AVUS, Starbem e DASA – Parceiras de saúde e bem-estar que completam o nosso cuidado integral com você.

️ Curso de idiomas (inglês ou espanhol) – Para expandir horizontes e crescer junto com a gente.

No dress code – Aqui você é livre para se vestir do seu jeito. Seja você.

Horário flexível – Para facilitar sua rotina.

Refeição e lanches na sede – Energia garantida com comida boa e sempre por perto.

Balas e doces sempre à disposição – Porque um docinho salva o dia!

title: Junior Developer (Devvit Platform)
description:
We're looking for a Junior Developer 100% remote in Brazil


Location: Remote (100%)

Employment Type: CLT

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Junior Developer to lead the creation of engaging, high-performance in-app community experiences aligned with major UK cultural moments. This role blends full-stack development with a deep understanding of online communities, culture, and data-driven iteration. You will own the full lifecycle of features—from concept to deployment—while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners to drive meaningful user engagement during peak activity periods.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the conceptualisation, design, and execution of in-app community experiences tailored to high-interest UK cultural moments.
  • Drive community engagement during peak user periods by launching client-facing, technically robust features built on the Devvit Developer Platform.
  • Translate cultural trends and community needs into scalable, high-performance web applications within a large social platform ecosystem.
  • Own the full development lifecycle, from ideation and prototyping through deployment and iteration.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the culture and technical needs of focus communities to inform content, feature sets, and engagement strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to convert strategic growth goals and community feedback into clear technical requirements and deliverables.
  • Conduct data analysis and research on application performance and usage metrics to guide feature prioritisation and optimisation.

Technical Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS .
  • Demonstrable expertise with modern client-side frameworks, particularly React .
  • Experience building and deploying server-side applications using Node.js , preferably with frameworks such as Express or Koa .
  • Strong understanding of API integration, data modelling, and client/server architecture patterns.
  • Experience managing application state and data using tools such as Redis for caching or storage.
  • Familiarity with the Devvit Developer Platform and its SDKs (@devvit/client, @devvit/server) is highly desirable.

General Requirements

  • Fluent in English , with a deep understanding of UK culture and language nuances.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple development and community launch cycles simultaneously.
  • Experience designing and executing community activations and interactive platform experiences.
  • Strong familiarity with large-scale online discussion platforms and user expectations.
  • Ability to quickly understand and adapt to diverse topics and content verticals.
  • Availability to dedicate 20–40 hours per week to community growth initiatives.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on high-impact community experiences tied to major cultural moments.
  • Autonomy to own features end-to-end in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Flexible contract hours within a globally distributed team.

If you are passionate about building community-driven products and enjoy combining cultural insight with technical excellence, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Full Stack Developer \"#988297\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e carrega quase 30 anos de experiência por meio de suas companhias legadas, principalmente a partir da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants .

Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2007 como DISYS e, desde então, atendemos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, nos consolidamos como uma das maiores empresas de soluções e contratação em TI, entregando serviços que combinam escala global, portfólio completo e agilidade tática , apoiando a modernização de modelos de contratação, evolução de soluções de workforce e transformação tecnológica.

Possuímos escritórios em Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , mantendo proximidade com nossos clientes e consultores. Somos também uma Minority Owner Company , com forte compromisso com diversidade, inclusão e equidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro da nossa estratégia e representam nosso maior ativo. Nosso compromisso é atrair, desenvolver e reter talentos, criando conexões reais e duradouras.

Acreditamos que a combinação certa entre talento, tecnologia e organizações desbloqueia resultados transformadores e impulsiona o sucesso de clientes e consultores.

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — orientam todas as nossas decisões.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento backend e no redesign de uma aplicação existente .
  • Evoluir e modernizar uma solução crítica utilizada para análise de dados do GitHub .
  • Integrar dados provenientes exclusivamente de APIs , garantindo confiabilidade e performance.
  • Projetar e implementar o banco de dados desde o início, incluindo:

- Criação e manutenção de tabelas;

- Evolução do modelo de dados;

- Otimização de queries e performance.

  • Trabalhar com SQL ANSI e Azure SQL Server em nível avançado.
  • Apoiar diretamente a tomada de decisões técnicas e estratégicas por meio de dados .
  • Atuar com CI/CD, versionamento e segurança de código , com forte uso de GitHub.
  • Colaborar com times internacionais (Scrum Master, stakeholders e customers globais).
  • Participar ativamente de um ambiente ágil, com foco em qualidade, escalabilidade e impacto de produto.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência consolidada como desenvolvedor(a) backend ou full stack.
  • Experiência sólida com banco de dados relacional
  • SQL ANSI
  • Microsoft Azure SQL Server
  • Criação e manutenção de tabelas
  • Otimização de queries
  • Performance e evolução de bancos de dados
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento backend , utilizando ao menos uma das linguagens:
  • JavaScript / TypeScript (Node.js)
  • Python
  • Vivência com consumo de APIs .
  • Experiência com GitHub , incluindo boas práticas de versionamento e segurança de código.
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e fundamentos de automação.
  • Experiência em Azure (AWS é aceitável, mas Azure é o ambiente principal).
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente — eliminatório.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência prévia com Snowflake (diferencial altamente relevante, roadmap futuro do projeto).
  • Conhecimento em .NET (ambiente Microsoft).
  • Experiência com automação e scripts (PowerShell, Bash, etc.).
  • Vivência em projetos de redesign ou modernização de aplicações .
  • Experiência com Scrum ou metodologias ágeis .
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança, cloud e automação .


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa — regime 100% Home Office .

CLT

  • Vale Refeição

  • Seguro de Vida

  • Auxílio Pet

Como Dexian, nos consolidamos como uma das maiores empresas de soluções e contratação em TI, entregando serviços que combinam escala global, portfólio completo e agilidade tática , apoiando a modernização de modelos de contratação, evolução de soluções de workforce e transformação tecnológica.

Possuímos escritórios em Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , mantendo proximidade com nossos clientes e consultores. Somos também uma Minority Owner Company , com forte compromisso com diversidade, inclusão e equidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro da nossa estratégia e representam nosso maior ativo. Nosso compromisso é atrair, desenvolver e reter talentos, criando conexões reais e duradouras.

Acreditamos que a combinação certa entre talento, tecnologia e organizações desbloqueia resultados transformadores e impulsiona o sucesso de clientes e consultores.

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — orientam todas as nossas decisões.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento backend e no redesign de uma aplicação existente .
  • Evoluir e modernizar uma solução crítica utilizada para análise de dados do GitHub .
  • Integrar dados provenientes exclusivamente de APIs , garantindo confiabilidade e performance.
  • Projetar e implementar o banco de dados desde o início, incluindo:

- Criação e manutenção de tabelas;

- Evolução do modelo de dados;

- Otimização de queries e performance.

  • Trabalhar com SQL ANSI e Azure SQL Server em nível avançado.
  • Apoiar diretamente a tomada de decisões técnicas e estratégicas por meio de dados .
  • Atuar com CI/CD, versionamento e segurança de código , com forte uso de GitHub.
  • Colaborar com times internacionais (Scrum Master, stakeholders e customers globais).
  • Participar ativamente de um ambiente ágil, com foco em qualidade, escalabilidade e impacto de produto.


O que você precisa ter

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Ascendion

Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.


Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life


We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for the world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience.


Experience a community of change-makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.


About the Role


Job Title: Data Scientist

Contract Type: Contract in Brazil

Office model - Remote


We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist focused on evaluating LLM-based products. The role is all about making sure AI outputs are high-quality, accurate, safe, and useful, using a mix of human evaluation and LLM-based evaluation approaches (LLM-as-a-Judge and LLM-as-a-Jury). You’ll work closely with SMEs, product, and engineering teams to build and scale evaluation frameworks that help improve AI products.


What You’ll Do:


  • Review and evaluate LLM outputs for quality, accuracy, safety, and relevance.
  • Work with SMEs on manual and human-in-the-loop evaluations.
  • Use LLMs to evaluate other LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge / LLM-as-a-Jury)
  • Define simple evaluation criteria and scoring guidelines.
  • Analyze results and share clear feedback with product and engineering teams.
  • Help improve evaluation processes and best practices over time.


What We’re Looking For:


  • 6-7 years of experience in Data Science, ML, or AI roles.
  • Strong experience with LLMs and Generative AI.
  • AWS: Core AWS - Lambda, EC2, S3, SQS, SNS, etc.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating LLM outputs (manual or automated).
  • Solid Python skills for analysis and automation.
  • Experience with LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral, or similar.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.


Nice to Haves:


  • Experience with AI evaluation metrics or quality frameworks.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps or AI monitoring.
  • Interest in AI safety, reliability, and responsible AI processes.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Full-Stack Developer / UI Designer
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a hybrid Developer/Designer who can build modern, scalable web

experiences using TypeScript, Next.js, Node and related technologies, while also producing

polished, on-brand UI/UX in Figma. This role blends engineering, design, and AI-assised

development. The ideal candidate moves quickly, takes initiative, and delivers exceptional

quality with minimal oversight.


Responsibilities

Full-Stack Web Development

● Build and maintain headless websites and applications using Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and TypeScript.

● Implement responsive, performant, and accessible front-end interfaces aligned with design specs.

● Develop backend functionality, APIs, serverless functions, and integrations.

● Ensure high standards for code quality, testing, maintainability, and documentation.

● Use AI-powered tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex/Copilot) to accelerate coding workflows and improve output quality.

● Identify architectural improvements, technical optimizations, and opportunities for automation.

● Collaborate with marketing, engineering, and product teams on cross-functional initiatives.


Web Design / UI & UX

● Create polished, intuitive, on-brand designs and prototypes in Figma.

● Maintain and evolve design systems, component libraries, and visual standards.

● Translate brand guidelines into consistent layouts, UI patterns, and interactions.

● Conduct UX improvements across flows, navigation, content structure, and responsiveness.

● Deliver clear handoff files, annotations, and design documentation to ensure smooth implementation.

● Contribute to concept development, ideation, and early-stage visual direction.


Required qualifications

● 4+ years of experience building headless websites or modern web apps, preferably with Next.js.

● Hands-on experience with headless CMSs (Contentful, Prismic, Sanity, etc.)

● Strong proficiency with React, Tailwind, Node.js, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.

● Demonstrated UI/UX ability with a portfolio of Figma designs.

● Experience creating or managing reusable design systems.

● Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex/Copilot).

● Ability to work independently, take initiative, and drive projects with minimal supervision.

● Strong understanding of accessibility, responsive design, and performance optimization.

● Excellent communication skills and comfort with asynchronous collaboration.

● Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with Pacific Time (8 AM–12 PM PT).


Preferred qualifications

● Experience with Webflow.

● Experience with Prismic CMS.

● Experience with cloud platforms (Vercel, AWS, GCP).

● Experience with CI/CD tools

● Experience with the HubSpot API.

● Experience maintaining design systems in Figma.

● Experience building API integrations.

Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar ambientes Kubernetes de missão crítica , com profunda expertise em GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine) e OKE (Oracle Kubernetes Engine) .
  • Definir e evoluir estratégias de monitoramento, logging e observabilidade , assegurando estabilidade, performance e rápida resposta a incidentes.

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Ascendion

Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.


Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life


We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for the world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience.


Experience a community of change-makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.


About the Role


Job Title: Data Scientist

Contract Type: Contract in Brazil

Office model - Remote


We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist focused on evaluating LLM-based products. The role is all about making sure AI outputs are high-quality, accurate, safe, and useful, using a mix of human evaluation and LLM-based evaluation approaches (LLM-as-a-Judge and LLM-as-a-Jury). You’ll work closely with SMEs, product, and engineering teams to build and scale evaluation frameworks that help improve AI products.


What You’ll Do:


  • Review and evaluate LLM outputs for quality, accuracy, safety, and relevance.
  • Work with SMEs on manual and human-in-the-loop evaluations.
  • Use LLMs to evaluate other LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge / LLM-as-a-Jury)
  • Define simple evaluation criteria and scoring guidelines.
  • Analyze results and share clear feedback with product and engineering teams.
  • Help improve evaluation processes and best practices over time.


What We’re Looking For:


  • 6-7 years of experience in Data Science, ML, or AI roles.
  • Strong experience with LLMs and Generative AI.
  • AWS: Core AWS - Lambda, EC2, S3, SQS, SNS, etc.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating LLM outputs (manual or automated).
  • Solid Python skills for analysis and automation.
  • Experience with LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral, or similar.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.


Nice to Haves:


  • Experience with AI evaluation metrics or quality frameworks.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps or AI monitoring.
  • Interest in AI safety, reliability, and responsible AI processes.

title: Junior Developer (Devvit Platform)
description:
We're looking for a Junior Developer 100% remote in Brazil


Location: Remote (100%)

Employment Type: CLT

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Junior Developer to lead the creation of engaging, high-performance in-app community experiences aligned with major UK cultural moments. This role blends full-stack development with a deep understanding of online communities, culture, and data-driven iteration. You will own the full lifecycle of features—from concept to deployment—while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners to drive meaningful user engagement during peak activity periods.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the conceptualisation, design, and execution of in-app community experiences tailored to high-interest UK cultural moments.
  • Drive community engagement during peak user periods by launching client-facing, technically robust features built on the Devvit Developer Platform.
  • Translate cultural trends and community needs into scalable, high-performance web applications within a large social platform ecosystem.
  • Own the full development lifecycle, from ideation and prototyping through deployment and iteration.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the culture and technical needs of focus communities to inform content, feature sets, and engagement strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to convert strategic growth goals and community feedback into clear technical requirements and deliverables.
  • Conduct data analysis and research on application performance and usage metrics to guide feature prioritisation and optimisation.

Technical Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS .
  • Demonstrable expertise with modern client-side frameworks, particularly React .
  • Experience building and deploying server-side applications using Node.js , preferably with frameworks such as Express or Koa .
  • Strong understanding of API integration, data modelling, and client/server architecture patterns.
  • Experience managing application state and data using tools such as Redis for caching or storage.
  • Familiarity with the Devvit Developer Platform and its SDKs (@devvit/client, @devvit/server) is highly desirable.

General Requirements

  • Fluent in English , with a deep understanding of UK culture and language nuances.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple development and community launch cycles simultaneously.
  • Experience designing and executing community activations and interactive platform experiences.
  • Strong familiarity with large-scale online discussion platforms and user expectations.
  • Ability to quickly understand and adapt to diverse topics and content verticals.
  • Availability to dedicate 20–40 hours per week to community growth initiatives.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on high-impact community experiences tied to major cultural moments.
  • Autonomy to own features end-to-end in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Flexible contract hours within a globally distributed team.

If you are passionate about building community-driven products and enjoy combining cultural insight with technical excellence, we’d love to hear from you.

title: SAP ABAP IBP Developer
description:
Senior SAP ABAP Developer (IBP / Finance Focus)

Project: IBP Rollout

Contract Duration: Start date 5th of January - 3 months + possible extension

Location: Remote but must be based in Brazil

Start Date: 4th of January

Workload: 5 days/week

Language: English and Portuguese


Seeking an experienced Senior SAP ABAP Developer to support its global IBP (Integrated Business Planning) implementation across Europe, North and South America. The consultant will replace an outgoing developer and play a key role in building and maintaining interfaces, enhancements, and integrations within the SAP ECC environment.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop and maintain custom ABAP programs, function modules, BADIs, BAPIs, and iDOCs
  • Design and implement integrations between SAP ECC and middleware tools (e.g., Workado)
  • Build custom tables and data interfaces to support IBP and Finance streams
  • Collaborate with functional teams, integration leads, and other developers across regions
  • Support performance optimization, troubleshooting, and documentation of technical solutions
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure compliance with SAP development standards


Required Skills & Experience


  • 5+ years of SAP ABAP development experience (ECC environment)
  • Proven experience in IBP and Finance integration projects
  • Strong understanding of data interfaces and integration frameworks (iDOCs, BAPIs, RFCs, BADIs)
  • Familiarity with middleware systems (Workado or similar)
  • Experience supporting international, multi-region SAP environments
  • Excellent English communication and team collaboration skills


Nice to Have


  • Exposure to SAP S/4HANA (awareness level acceptable) Not mandatory
  • Previous experience in manufacturing / industrial sectors

title: Consultor SAP HCM Sênior (Time & Folha) com conhecimento em EHS
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Sobre a oportunidade:


Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) SAP HCM Sênior , com sólida experiência em Time Management e Folha de Pagamento , e conhecimento em EHS (Environment, Health and Safety) para atuar em projeto estratégico de SAP. O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir a integração entre os módulos de RH e segurança do trabalho, contribuindo para a eficiência e conformidade dos processos.


Local: 100% remoto


Responsabilidades:

  • Parametrizar e manter os módulos SAP HCM – Time Management e Payroll ;
  • Atuar em integrações entre HCM e EHS , assegurando a correta gestão de dados de colaboradores e saúde ocupacional;
  • Apoiar o time técnico e funcional na resolução de incidentes e melhorias;
  • Elaborar documentação funcional , testes e suporte às áreas usuárias;
  • Colaborar com diferentes áreas do negócio, garantindo alinhamento das soluções às práticas corporativas;

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)

  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday
