title: Team Leader
description:
Team Leader

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.




Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?


Garantir a entrega de valor ao cliente por meio da gestão integrada de pessoas, processos e relacionamentos, promovendo o desenvolvimento das pessoas, a eficiência operacional e a geração de novas oportunidades de negócio.


Como será seu dia a dia?


  • Acompanhar a performance das pessoas junto ao Cliente
  • Apoiar o(a) Delivery Manager (DM) nas atividades do dia a dia e nas decisões relacionadas ao time e ao cliente. (Acompanhar KPIs; Prestar suporte à área técnica com análises e percepções sobre desempenho; ferramentas como Sólides, sistemas de apropriação e service desk.)
  • Apoiar o(a) Delivery Manager (DM/GPM) na elaboração de planos de ação relacionados à pesquisa de NPS
  • Facilitar cerimônias e eventos com o time para garantir a integração
  • Promover reuniões com os Clientes para gerar novos negócios e benchmarking
  • Identificar riscos e propor soluções para manter o atendimento de qualidade das pessoas alocadas.
  • Fomentar o desenvolvimento profissional das pessoas, aplicando boas práticas..
  • Atuar na resolução de conflitos e na motivação da equipe para alcançar altos níveis de desempenho.
  • Garantir a comunicação e relacionamento eficiente entre stakeholders, clientes e equipe.
  • Coletar feedbacks das lideranças do cliente sobre os colaboradores alocados
  • Realizar reuniões de feedback com os liderados e registrar nas ferramentas internas
  • Estruturar Planos de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) junto aos liderados, visando não apenas o aumento de performance e produtividade, mas também o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional do liderado.
  • Entender tanto o negócio quanto os produtos do cliente, identificando oportunidades de crescimento e propondo melhorias para fortalecer a entrega de valor.
  • Realizar acompanhamento de aprovações de férias, banco de horas, atestados médicos e folgas, além do apontamento de horas e ponto.
  • Monitorar e analisar regularmente indicadores financeiros da operação, identificando áreas de melhoria e ajustando estratégias conforme necessário.
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de performance e indicadores gerais para conhecer as métricas do time
  • Levantar, junto aos clientes, as necessidades de novas demandas e alocação de profissionais
  • Acompanhar, junto aos líderes de áreas de RH, o processo seletivo de novos profissionais para o time
  • Conduzir os ritos de Onboarding e alinhamentos iniciais com informações sobre o contexto que os profissionais irão atuar na Rethink.
  • Realizar a movimentação dos profissionais caso aconteça mudança/saída do contexto de atuação
  • Promover encontros recorrentes com as áreas (Engenharia, Produto, Design, Qualidade, Delivery) para favorecer a integração entre os times e o desenvolvimento das skills comuns



O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?


Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers


Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber


Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo



Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?


  • Inscrição
  • Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  • Bate-papo com People
  • Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.
  • Entrevista técnica com liderança
  • Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.
  • Feedback final
  • Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.



Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Senior Tax Consultant
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em Tax One e DFE , com forte experiência em suporte funcional e operacional de soluções fiscais brasileiras .


Contrato: Part-time

Local: 100% Remoto


Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar no suporte funcional das soluções fiscais Tax One e DFE , analisando e resolvendo tickets relacionados a obrigações fiscais.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs , assegurando qualidade e prazos nas entregas.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato entre áreas fiscais, times de negócio, TI e fornecedores de soluções fiscais .
  • Analisar erros, rejeições e inconsistências em documentos fiscais eletrônicos .
  • Apoiar na parametrização, validação e testes de regras fiscais.
  • Identificar riscos fiscais, gargalos operacionais e propor melhorias nos processos e no modelo de suporte .


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência como Especialista em Tax One e DFE ou atuação similar como Consultor(a) Fiscal .
  • Conhecimento aprofundado da legislação fiscal brasileira .
  • Experiência com gestão de tickets e SLAs em ambientes de suporte.
  • Vivência prática com documentos fiscais eletrônicos (NF-e, NFS-e, CT-e, MDF-e, entre outros).
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma integrada com times de TI e negócio.
  • Inglês obrigatório.

title: Oracle Business System Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Oracle Fusion who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

We are seeking an Oracle Business Systems Analyst (BSA), with functional experience with Oracle ERP Cloud, Supply Chain processes and Oracle GTM (Global Trade Management) module. Optionally, also have experience with both of the Order to Cash and Procure to Pay business processes and modules including (but not limited to): AP, AR, G/L, Cash Management, Order Management, and Inventory. This BSA will help define the integration of our GTM Application with Oracle products. Our ONESOURCE Integrations for Oracle is a key component of our product suite. As an Oracle BSA, he will be responsible for developing functional requirement, API mapping specs, test cases plans, validating acceptance criteria and documentation, as related to the integration processes between Oracle and ONESOURCE Global Trade.



Tasks Performed :


• Work closely with customers, prospects and Product Management in setting the direction of current and future the ONESOURCE Global Trade Integration for Oracle as well as helping to continue to maintain ONESOURCE Global Trade integration for Oracle competitive differentiation.


• Perform detailed analysis of ONSOURCE business integration with Oracle modules, primarily GTM to determine opportunities to strengthen and expand integration design.


• Prepare detailed Oracle Integration Requirement Specs & Functional Documentation with associated use cases, Define interface mapping rules, PowerPoint presentations, and other documents to explain requirements to Development, support teams, partners and customers.


• Demonstrate the ability to research and understand Oracle Fusion APIs.


• Perform feature validation of functionality, QA in test script creation and automation, and assist with end-user documentation


• Perform Oracle application configuration settings and options for relevant modules


• Assist in providing 2nd level support and training to Support and Professional Services staff



Essential Functions:


• Maintain a working relationship with internal customers including Product Development, Professional Services, Customer Advocacy, as well as Oracle via the Oracle Partner Program


• Gather, define and document Oracle business requirements


• Work closely with application developers, other BSA’s and QA testers throughout the entire product life cycle


• Participate in customer calls, visits and meetings to gather requirements and resolve issues


• Support product rollouts and implementations as domain expert and/or primary business interface to partner domain experts. Follow product into the field to ensure customer success.


• Support current products, including 2nd level support analysis, patch assessment, and work-around investigation


• Provide business and data integration expertise to customers, partners and internal professional services personnel as needed.



Desired Job Experience:


• Requires a minimum of 1-3 years functional experience in key Oracle modules (Supply Chain Management and GTM), including requirements gathering, design, configuration, unit testing and integration testing.


• Experience with a full life cycle Oracle implementations


• Experience with Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion) required


• Strong analytical, design and documentation skills


• Oracle design, configuration and hands on experience


• Exposure to broad financial processes and systems experience across quote-to-cash and procure-to-pay business functions (billing, order management, accounts receivable, purchasing, accounts payable, general ledger.)


• Experience with standard financial processes and ability to overlay the process understanding onto multiple financial business systems packages.


• Previous experience working in a software company strongly desired.


• Desirable experience in Oracle modules AP, AR, G/L, Order Management and Purchasing .


• Previous work with Oracle R12 EBS is a plus


• Experience with ONESOURCE Global Trade will be a plus



Other Qualifications:


• Excellent communication and presentation skills in interacting with management and communicating functional vision to both internal and external constituencies


• Strong customer-facing experience and skills.


• Experience with Agile Product Delivery Process , specifically Scrum is a plus


• Strong communication and presentation skills


• Technical/ Oracle development experience (Foundation, SQL*Plus, System Administration) is a plus


• Technical experience working with APIs (SOAP and REST) and API tools, such as SoapUi and Postman is a plus


• Ability to multi-task and work under tight deadlines in a fast paced environment

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

title: Oracle Business System Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Oracle Fusion who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

We are seeking an Oracle Business Systems Analyst (BSA), with functional experience with Oracle ERP Cloud, Supply Chain processes and Oracle GTM (Global Trade Management) module. Optionally, also have experience with both of the Order to Cash and Procure to Pay business processes and modules including (but not limited to): AP, AR, G/L, Cash Management, Order Management, and Inventory. This BSA will help define the integration of our GTM Application with Oracle products. Our ONESOURCE Integrations for Oracle is a key component of our product suite. As an Oracle BSA, he will be responsible for developing functional requirement, API mapping specs, test cases plans, validating acceptance criteria and documentation, as related to the integration processes between Oracle and ONESOURCE Global Trade.



Tasks Performed :


• Work closely with customers, prospects and Product Management in setting the direction of current and future the ONESOURCE Global Trade Integration for Oracle as well as helping to continue to maintain ONESOURCE Global Trade integration for Oracle competitive differentiation.


• Perform detailed analysis of ONSOURCE business integration with Oracle modules, primarily GTM to determine opportunities to strengthen and expand integration design.


• Prepare detailed Oracle Integration Requirement Specs & Functional Documentation with associated use cases, Define interface mapping rules, PowerPoint presentations, and other documents to explain requirements to Development, support teams, partners and customers.


• Demonstrate the ability to research and understand Oracle Fusion APIs.


• Perform feature validation of functionality, QA in test script creation and automation, and assist with end-user documentation


• Perform Oracle application configuration settings and options for relevant modules


• Assist in providing 2nd level support and training to Support and Professional Services staff



Essential Functions:


• Maintain a working relationship with internal customers including Product Development, Professional Services, Customer Advocacy, as well as Oracle via the Oracle Partner Program


• Gather, define and document Oracle business requirements


• Work closely with application developers, other BSA’s and QA testers throughout the entire product life cycle


• Participate in customer calls, visits and meetings to gather requirements and resolve issues


• Support product rollouts and implementations as domain expert and/or primary business interface to partner domain experts. Follow product into the field to ensure customer success.


• Support current products, including 2nd level support analysis, patch assessment, and work-around investigation


• Provide business and data integration expertise to customers, partners and internal professional services personnel as needed.



Desired Job Experience:


• Requires a minimum of 1-3 years functional experience in key Oracle modules (Supply Chain Management and GTM), including requirements gathering, design, configuration, unit testing and integration testing.


• Experience with a full life cycle Oracle implementations


• Experience with Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion) required


• Strong analytical, design and documentation skills


• Oracle design, configuration and hands on experience


• Exposure to broad financial processes and systems experience across quote-to-cash and procure-to-pay business functions (billing, order management, accounts receivable, purchasing, accounts payable, general ledger.)


• Experience with standard financial processes and ability to overlay the process understanding onto multiple financial business systems packages.


• Previous experience working in a software company strongly desired.


• Desirable experience in Oracle modules AP, AR, G/L, Order Management and Purchasing .


• Previous work with Oracle R12 EBS is a plus


• Experience with ONESOURCE Global Trade will be a plus



Other Qualifications:


• Excellent communication and presentation skills in interacting with management and communicating functional vision to both internal and external constituencies


• Strong customer-facing experience and skills.


• Experience with Agile Product Delivery Process , specifically Scrum is a plus


• Strong communication and presentation skills


• Technical/ Oracle development experience (Foundation, SQL*Plus, System Administration) is a plus


• Technical experience working with APIs (SOAP and REST) and API tools, such as SoapUi and Postman is a plus


• Ability to multi-task and work under tight deadlines in a fast paced environment

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of professional full stack software development experience to join our U.K. / U.S. client. You will help build the foundation of the client's back-end and data systems. The role will focus on platform development using Supabase, TypeScript, and modern web frameworks, enabling robust data pipelines, operations automation, and API integrations that support the client's growing applications.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and extend back-end systems using Supabase, leveraging database, auth, and edge function capabilities
  • Develop and maintain TypeScript-based APIs and integrations that underpin the client's platform and data services
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to deliver end-to-end features and performant, user-facing experiences
  • Contribute to the evolution of the client's internal automation tools and data pipeline implementations
  • Work closely with product, data, and AI teams on new integrations from analytics and forecasting to blockchain-enabled features
  • Ensure reliability, performance, and scalability while maintaining lightweight, maintainable systems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience in full stack or back-end development with strong proficiency in TypeScript
  • Practical experience with Supabase (preferred) or NextJS, Express, or other TypeScript frameworks
  • Solid understanding of API design, database schema design, and serverless architecture patterns
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Experience using AI tooling, such as Cursor and CoPilot
  • Experience working independently in Agile, distributed teams
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Familiarity with AI or ML integrations at the application level
  • Knowledge of blockchain, digital asset verification, or sustainability data systems
  • Experience with data visualization, analytics tools, or geospatial data


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Executivo (a) Comercial Externo
description:
Executivo(a) Comercial | Transforme o Setor de Energia com a Gente!


⚡ Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil


Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.


A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.


Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui


Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo


Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.


Você será a peça-chave para:


  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.


Principais Responsabilidades:


️Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional Desenvolvedor Full Stack venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack experiente para integrar nosso time de tecnologia. O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e manter aplicações do time utilizando as principais tecnologias do mercado. Nossa principal aplicação, FTS de Crédito, é um sistema que conecta os canais do banco e é a porta de entrada para as operações de crédito e garantias, incluindo empréstimos, fianças, compras de dívida e carteiras. Atuamos em diversos países, como Chile, Luxemburgo, México, e estamos expandindo para Estados Unidos e Peru. Nosso desafio é manter o sistema estável enquanto modernizamos a tecnologia e ampliamos a atuação internacional. Responsabilidades Desenvolver e manter aplicações front-end utilizando Angular (versões recentes) Criar e evoluir APIs e serviços back-end com Node.js e .NET Projetar e implementar soluções de banco de dados SQL (PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB/DocumentDB) Participar de todas as fases do desenvolvimento, desde a concepção até o deploy Garantir a qualidade do código através de testes e boas práticas Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares em um ambiente ágil Realizar code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos

Experiência sólida com Node.js e desenvolvimento de APIs Domínio de .NET (C#) e ASP.NET Core e Node ,conhecimento avançado em Angular (preferencialmente versões 20)

Experiência com bancos de dados PostgreSQL Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL (MongoDB e/ou DocumentDB)

Versionamento de código com Git Conhecimento em TypeScript Ingles intermediario

Requisitos Desejáveis

Experiência com NestJS Conhecimento em arquitetura de microserviços Conhecimento em arquitetura de microfrontend Familiaridade com Docker e containerização Experiência com Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD RxJS e programação reativa Testes unitários e de integração (Jest, xUnit) Conhecimento em padrões de projeto Diferenciais Conhecimento em mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS) Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps


Modelo Remoto

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: .NET/C# - React (Fullstack)
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a .NET/C# and React Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to our platform's evolution by developing innovative features and ensuring its ongoing stability through close collaboration with a cross-functional team. This role is responsible for contributing to the full software development lifecycle, from concept and design to deployment and maintenance, while upholding high standards for code quality and performance. You will play a fundamental part in delivering a robust and scalable user experience, working in a supportive, team-oriented environment alongside other engineers and product stakeholders to bring new capabilities to life.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications, ensuring code is clean, performant, and adheres to high-quality standards;
  • Work closely with multidisciplinary teams—including Product, QA, and UX—in agile settings to deliver resilient solutions that support strategic business objectives;
  • Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and propose architectural improvements to optimize platform performance and reliability;
  • Provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team, promoting best development practices and contributing to team growth.


Essential Skills

  • Experience with the .NET/C# ecosystem for backend development and React for frontend in cloud-based (SaaS) environments;
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with AWS cloud platform (preferred), microservices architecture, and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Deep knowledge of SQL and database design for both relational and non-relational systems (Postgres, MongoDB);
  • Familiarity with building and maintaining continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and DevOps practices;
  • Knowledge or hands-on experience with the Angular framework for frontend development.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • Organização, autonomia e gestão do tempo
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e resiliente

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Software Engineer Full Stack Pleno
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões de rodada em investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro.

A tecnologia está no centro do que fazemos. Nossas equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de sistemas, banco de dados, experiência do usuário, cibersegurança e data & analytics atuam em conjunto para construir o sistema operacional do agronegócio. Em um setor que se transforma todos os dias, somos reconhecidos por liderar essa mudança com visão estratégica.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver interfaces de usuário modernas e responsivas e participar ativamente da implementação de soluções escaláveis e resilientes;
  • Trabalhar transversalmente com squads, garantindo boas práticas de engenharia e decisões consistentes com a visão de longo prazo da plataforma;
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, design de sistemas, arquitetura e iniciativas de refatoração estratégica;
  • Colaborar com áreas de produto e negócios para traduzir necessidades em soluções técnicas viáveis;
  • Garantir excelência na experiência do usuário e performance front-end;
  • Conduzir iniciativas de inovação tecnológica, incluindo POCs e adoção de novas ferramentas ou paradigmas.


Competências:

  • Experiência com stacks como: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, Node.js (NestJS), PostgreSQL..
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes altamente regulados ou em fintechs / agtechs / software as a service (saas);
  • Participação ativa em comunidades técnicas ou iniciativas open source;
  • Antifragilidade, pronto para desbravar entregas críticas para o sucesso do negócio;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de software e design de arquitetura de serviços e dados;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Engenharia;
  • Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (4+ anos), com histórico de impacto técnico significativo;
  • Experiência com Angular e desenvolvimento de SPAs (Single Page Applications);
  • Experiência com APIs REST;
  • Vivência com infraestrutura em nuvem (preferencialmente GCP), automação de infraestrutura (IaC), CI/CD e observabilidade;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (preferencialmente PostgreSQL) e não relacionais em alta escala;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e não técnicas.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento ou experiência com Rust;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados geoespaciais no front-end (mapas, geolocalização);
  • Conhecimento sobre os conceitos base da Cloud – containers, VMs e GCP (organização, projetos, regiões, zonas, IAM);
  • Conhecimento dos principais conceitos e funcionalidades como Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, etc;
  • Conhecimento em Terraform.


O que temos por aqui:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado (PJ);
  • Benefício flexível por meio do cartão Swile;
  • Gympass;
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde;
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto;
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto.

description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões de rodada em investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro.

A tecnologia está no centro do que fazemos. Nossas equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de sistemas, banco de dados, experiência do usuário, cibersegurança e data & analytics atuam em conjunto para construir o sistema operacional do agronegócio. Em um setor que se transforma todos os dias, somos reconhecidos por liderar essa mudança com visão estratégica.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver interfaces de usuário modernas e responsivas e participar ativamente da implementação de soluções escaláveis e resilientes;
  • Trabalhar transversalmente com squads, garantindo boas práticas de engenharia e decisões consistentes com a visão de longo prazo da plataforma;
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, design de sistemas, arquitetura e iniciativas de refatoração estratégica;
  • Colaborar com áreas de produto e negócios para traduzir necessidades em soluções técnicas viáveis;
  • Garantir excelência na experiência do usuário e performance front-end;
  • Conduzir iniciativas de inovação tecnológica, incluindo POCs e adoção de novas ferramentas ou paradigmas.


Competências:

  • Experiência com stacks como: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, Node.js (NestJS), PostgreSQL..
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes altamente regulados ou em fintechs / agtechs / software as a service (saas);
  • Participação ativa em comunidades técnicas ou iniciativas open source;
  • Antifragilidade, pronto para desbravar entregas críticas para o sucesso do negócio;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de software e design de arquitetura de serviços e dados;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Engenharia;
  • Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (4+ anos), com histórico de impacto técnico significativo;
  • Experiência com Angular e desenvolvimento de SPAs (Single Page Applications);
  • Experiência com APIs REST;
  • Vivência com infraestrutura em nuvem (preferencialmente GCP), automação de infraestrutura (IaC), CI/CD e observabilidade;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (preferencialmente PostgreSQL) e não relacionais em alta escala;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e não técnicas.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento ou experiência com Rust;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados geoespaciais no front-end (mapas, geolocalização);
  • Conhecimento sobre os conceitos base da Cloud – containers, VMs e GCP (organização, projetos, regiões, zonas, IAM);
  • Conhecimento dos principais conceitos e funcionalidades como Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, etc;
  • Conhecimento em Terraform.


O que temos por aqui:

title: DevOps Pleno - GCP
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em GCP , com vivência prática em serviços como Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com Oracle Cloud (OCI).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology.

Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


The Mission

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to replace a key member of our technical team. You will be joining a group working on a revolutionary product designed to completely transform the United States Insurance Industry. This is not just a standard CRUD application; we are building complex workflows involving AI agents and browser-based tooling to modernize a legacy industry.


The Role

You will act as a Full Stack Developer with a heavy emphasis on Backend and AI logic. While Python is your primary weapon for new development, you must be versatile enough to tune existing Node.js services and handle frontend requirements in Angular and Chrome Extensions.

We are looking for someone who understands Agentic Workflows —how to organize AI models to perform complex tasks—not just someone who knows how to make a simple API call to OpenAI.


Key Responsibilities

  • AI & Backend Architecture: Design and implement robust backend services using Python. You will lead the development of AI Agents, defining how they interact, manage context, and execute tasks.
  • Browser-Based Innovation : Maintain and expand our core Chrome Extension product. This is a critical interface for our users.
  • Service Tuning: Interface with and optimize existing microservices written in Node.js . You don’t need to be a Node expert, but you must be comfortable reading, debugging, and tuning this code.
  • Frontend Maintenance: implement UI/UX features using Angular . While the role is backend-heavy, you should be comfortable jumping into the frontend to ship complete features.
  • Light Infrastructure: Handle very basic deployment or configuration tasks (DevOps is not a primary duty, but “infrastructure awareness” is required).


What we’re looking for

  • Seniority: 5+ years of commercial software development experience.
  • Python Mastery: Deep experience with Python for backend development.
  • AI/Agent Experience: proven experience working with LLMs and AI Agents. You understand the architecture of agentic frameworks (loops, memory, tools).
  • Note: Specific framework knowledge (LangChain, CrewAI) is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp of how agents are organized is mandatory.
  • Node.js Proficiency: Ability to read, understand, and patch Node.js environments.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Experience building or maintaining complex browser extensions (manifest v3, background scripts, content injection).
  • Previous experience in the InsurTech or Fintech sectors.
  • Background in modernizing legacy workflows with automation.
  • Familiarity with Angular .


Why Join Us?

  • Impact: Work on a product that is actively changing how the US insurance market operates.
  • Cutting Edge Tech: We are not just talking about AI; we are implementing agentic workflows in production.
  • Remote Culture: Work from anywhere with a team that values output over hours.

title: Executive Search Consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:

Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.


About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.


WHAT YOU WILL DO


Candidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)

  • Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
  • Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
  • Passive search: Source, screen applicants
  • Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessment


End to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)

  • Build and manage candidate pipeline
  • Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
  • Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
  • Support client communications and progress check-ins.
  • Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.


Business Development Support (10%)

  • Research companies, markets, and potential clients
  • Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
  • Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the company


IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
  • Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
  • Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
  • Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
  • Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
  • Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:


looking for a kind and curious Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving challenging problems. Our awesome team of friendly humans is responsible for making it easy and compelling for individuals to consign items .

We place a strong focus on individual growth and personal development on our collaborative engineering team. As a Senior Software Engineer you will be an active hands-on contributor as well as a strong influencer for our technical direction.

You will be able to lead and contribute to significant initiatives as well as provide mentorship through code reviews and pairing.

We are especially excited about you if you are enthusiastic about working in the luxury retail/e-commerce space or if you are passionate about our mission of sustainability in creating a circular economy for high-end goods.

This role reports to the Engineering Manager of Customer Experience and will be fully remote.

title: Account Executive
description:
Near is a startup focused on bridging the gap between remote Latin American talent and companies hiring in the US and abroad. Our team spans 20+ members across four different countries. We've landed numerous great customers and have helped hundreds of people from LatAm improve their lives and wallets with jobs at US companies.


We're looking for a driven and entrepreneurial Account Executive who is autonomous, creative, and enterprising to join our team. This is a financially rewarding opportunity with a highly competitive compensation structure – uncapped commission. If you can source and qualify leads effectively, you'll make a lot of money.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute plans to achieve sales targets
  • Expand revenue originated from existing accounts
  • Create new opportunities through outbound prospecting.
  • Close inbound leads
  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships
  • Leverage our existing network to get referrals
  • Understand industry-specific landscapes and trends.
  • Become an expert in the staffing industry.


Qualifications:

  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Native-like English level
  • Demonstrated ability to problem solve and effectively manage time.
  • A proactive mindset: always pursuing your next goal.
  • Motivated by commission and career growth.
  • Track record of exceeding quota as SDR.


Traits that Would Make You a Strong Fit:

  • Proactive.
  • Optimistic and positive.
  • Intense, driving, and impatient (with regard to results and getting work done).
  • Pay attention to detail when necessary.
  • High EQ – can read the room and connect with people
  • Responds empathetic to others.
  • Follow-through skills.
  • Accountability


Benefits :

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Uncapped commission – the more you close, the higher your commission will be.
  • Results-focused role and team. No BS. No unnecessary processes and bureaucracy.
  • Opportunity to grow and work on larger and more complex deals.
  • A team with a great culture.
  • Join a team of high-performers.

title: Full Stack AI Software Engineers
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: React, Redux, Mui, react-query, react-table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)
  • Successful track record in high‑growth lean startup environments
  • Ability to make independent decisions in fast‑changing contexts
  • Experience working in fully remote distributed engineering teams
  • Familiarity with Agile project management and defect tracking tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving abilities


Preferred Experience (desired but not required)

  • Technical or engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with white‑label SaaS architectures
  • Exposure to AI agent orchestration tools or workflow engines
  • Experience with test automation frameworks


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Analista BI
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida na construção de dashboards em Power BI
  • Vivência na tradução de demandas de negócio em indicadores estratégicos
  • Conhecimento em Python para tratamento e análise de dados
  • Domínio das ferramentas Microsoft (Excel, SQL Server, entre outras)
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs e integrações entre sistemas
  • Comunicação clara, com foco em transformar dados em insights acionáveis

⭐ Diferenciais

  • Experiência com indicadores financeiros, de projetos e de pessoas
  • Vivência em storytelling com dados
  • Conhecimento em outras ferramentas de visualização e análise
  • Atuação em projetos de indicadores estratégicos para alta gestão



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Sr Salesforce Release Engineer
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Job Description:

Salesforce Release Engineer with expertise in managing Salesforce deployments, release automation, CI/CD pipelines, and version control. The ideal candidate will work closely with development, admin, QA, and business teams to ensure smooth, accurate, and secure Salesforce releases across environments.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Plan, manage, and execute Salesforce release cycles (Sprint deployments, Hotfixes, Patch Releases).
  • Automate deployments using Salesforce DevOps tools (Flosum / Copado / Gearset / AutoRABIT).
  • Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines, version control strategy, and branching model (Git).
  • Perform metadata and data deployments using Change Sets, DevOps tools, and Salesforce CLI (SFDX).
  • Ensure code quality and compliance checks using static code analysis tools (PMD, SonarQube etc.).
  • Perform sandbox refresh strategy, data seeding, and environment management.
  • Troubleshoot deployment/release failures and provide root-cause analysis.
  • Document release processes, deployment logs, runbooks, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Developers, Admins, QA, Business Analysts).
  • Maintain adherence to security, governance, and audit requirements during releases.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Senior AEM Developer
description:
Job Description – Senior AEM Developer


Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior AEM Developer to work on the project that manages all the institutional pages of a client's domain in the insurance sector, as well as lead capture forms and product acquisition flows (Insurance, Banking, Services).


This professional will work on the end‑to‑end development and maintenance of AEM solutions—components, templates, integrations, and support for the Java BFF layer—within a modern architecture that integrates AEM, Next.js, Adobe Commerce, and an AWS Serverless middleware (Carbon).


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, maintain, and enhance applications using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), including components, models, templates, and pages.
  • Implement and maintain the Java BFF layer running on serverless architecture.
  • Create and maintain custom administrative dashboards within AEM CMS.
  • Integrate AEM with multiple corporate APIs, ensuring security, performance, and stability.
  • Collaborate with React/Next.js teams for visual and structural integration (preferred).
  • Work closely with architecture, backend, and middleware teams to ensure technical consistency.
  • Analyze technical impacts and propose improvements for scalability, performance, resilience, and user experience.
  • Provide technical support for Adobe Commerce, Carbon middleware, and AWS serverless integrations.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, refinement sessions, and technical discussions.
  • Lead complex technical analyses and mentor less‑experienced developers.


Technical Requirements


  • Senior‑level experience with Adobe Experience Manager 6.x+ :
  • Component, model, template, and page development
  • Sling Models & OSGi
  • HTL templating
  • AEM Sites / AEM Author
  • Strong expertise in Java , ideally with serverless architecture.
  • Experience with REST API integrations, authentication, security, and data handling.
  • Knowledge of performance tuning and caching strategies for AEM.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git/GitFlow.
  • Ability to work within complex architectures (AEM + Middleware + APIs + Front‑end).
  • Experience with cloud environments (preferably AWS ).


Preferred Technical Competencies


  • Knowledge of React and collaboration with frontend teams.
  • Experience with Next.js (SSR/SSG).
  • Familiarity with Adobe Commerce (Magento) for cart/checkout flows.
  • Experience with microservices or event‑driven architectures.
  • Experience with logging, monitoring, distributed tracing.


Behavioral Competencies


  • Strong analytical capability and autonomy in technical decision‑making.
  • Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Technical leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Systemic thinking to operate across integrated architectures (AEM + BFF + Middleware + Commerce).
  • Proactivity in problem-solving and risk identification.
  • Organization and discipline in documentation and execution.


Skill Set Summary


  • AEM 6.x+ (components, Sling, OSGi, Sites, dispatcher basics)
  • Java (serverless, REST APIs, architectural patterns)
  • AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, serverless services)
  • Git/GitFlow
  • Corporate API integrations
  • Basic understanding of React/Next.js
  • Knowledge of security, monitoring, logging, and performance best practices

Requisitos obrigatórios:


  • Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead Java.

  • Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL).

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs.

  • Conhecimento em MongoDB e PL/SQL.
